verifiedBehavior: Durable frontiers contain at most two eligible plan items. A descendant starts only after all prerequisite coverage results have been saved.
Nodes see only active obligations; the domain store retains the full plan and all earlier gaps/coverage. Coverage readiness is not final claim verification.
A failed prerequisite blocks its descendants, but eligible independent branches can still execute. Uninvestigated descendants retain explicit unchecked gaps.
Pending and applied frontier transition identities survive process/checkpoint replay. The global targeted requery counter is not reset between frontiers.
Human plan edits archive prior dependency state and clear the old checkpoint transition. A withdrawn scheduled descendant is not dispatched on resume.
At most two local retrieval jobs are admitted concurrently. Each uses the existing tracked call identity, atomic budget, scope and execution status.
Cancellation stops admission; confirmed in-flight results remain audited. Observed errors stop further admission; no automatic retry.
Normalized source and obligation order is independent of tool completion order. Conflicting original text under one source identity is rejected.
The contract is server-owned and immutable. Unmarked historical runs retain sequential behavior.
boundary: Real compiled LangGraph, SQLite, checkpoint and tracked-tool tests with fixed model responses. No scientific content or live parallel quality score. D1-v9 has separate authorization and receipts.
